# Trip Log

Purpose

Make a log of the photos taken using an Android phone. This log can be used in several ways.

Show the route taken on a map.

Add location information to other photos taken at about the same time.

Analyze the route based on the positions along the route.

```{r}
#| label: Initialize
#| message: false
#| echo:    false
#| warning: false

library(exifr)
library(dplyr)
library(xml2)

# --- Configuration ---
folder_path <- "Kyoto_1" # **CHANGE THIS to your actual folder path**
output_gpx_file <- "photo_track.gpx" # Name of your output GPX file

# --- 1. Extract EXIF Data ---
cat("Extracting EXIF data from photos...\n")

# Get a list of all image files (adjust patterns if you have other formats like .png)
image_files <- list.files(
  path = folder_path,
  pattern = "\\.jpg$|\\.jpeg$|\\.heic$", # Common image extensions
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE # Set to TRUE if you have subfolders
)

if (length(image_files) == 0) {
  stop("No image files found in the specified folder. Please check the 'folder_path' and 'pattern'.")
}

# Read EXIF data. We specifically want GPS and time information.
# Common tags: GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude, GPSAltitude, DateTimeOriginal, CreateDate
# Google Photos often stores location data in GPSLatitude/Longitude.
# DateTimeOriginal is usually the shot time.
exif_data <- read_exif(
  path = image_files,
  tags = c("SourceFile", "DateTimeOriginal", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude", "GPSAltitude"),
  quiet = TRUE # Set to FALSE for more verbose output from ExifTool
)

cat("EXIF data extraction complete. Found data for", nrow(exif_data), "images.\n")

# --- 2. Process and Clean Data ---

# Filter out rows that don't have essential GPS data
gps_data <- exif_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(GPSLatitude) & !is.na(GPSLongitude)) %>%
  # Handle different time tags if DateTimeOriginal is missing
  mutate(time = coalesce(DateTimeOriginal)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time)) %>%
  # Convert time to POSIXct for proper sorting and GPX format
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(time, format = "%Y:%m:%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  # Sort by time to create a chronological track
  arrange(time) %>%
  # Select only the columns needed for GPX
  select(time, GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude, GPSAltitude)

if (nrow(gps_data) == 0) {
  stop("No photos with valid GPS and time data found. Cannot create a GPX track.")
}

cat("Found", nrow(gps_data), "photos with valid GPS and time data.\n")

# --- 3. Create GPX XML Structure ---

cat("Creating GPX file...\n")

# Start building the GPX XML structure
gpx_root <- xml_new_root("gpx",
                         version = "1.1",
                         creator = "R-Photo-to-GPX-Converter",
                         namespaces = c(
                           gpx = "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1",
                           xsi = "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance",
                           "xsi:schemaLocation" = "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1 http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1/gpx.xsd"
                         ))

# Add a track element
track_node <- xml_add_child(gpx_root, "trk")
xml_add_child(track_node, "name", "Google Photos Track")
xml_add_child(track_node, "desc", "GPS track generated from Google Photos EXIF data")

# Add a track segment
trackseg_node <- xml_add_child(track_node, "trkseg")

# Iterate through each row of the processed data and add track points
for (i in 1:nrow(gps_data)) {
  trkpt_node <- xml_add_child(trackseg_node, "trkpt",
                              lat = as.character(gps_data$GPSLatitude[i]),
                              lon = as.character(gps_data$GPSLongitude[i]))

  # Add elevation if available
  if (!is.na(gps_data$GPSAltitude[i])) {
    xml_add_child(trkpt_node, "ele", as.character(round(gps_data$GPSAltitude[i], 2))) # Round elevation for cleaner output
  }

  # Add time in ISO 8601 format (required for GPX)
  # Format as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ" (Z indicates UTC)
  xml_add_child(trkpt_node, "time", format(gps_data$time[i], format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"))
}

# --- 4. Write the GPX File ---
write_xml(gpx_root, file = output_gpx_file, options = c("format", "no_declaration")) # Use 'format' for pretty printing

cat("\nGPX file '", output_gpx_file, "' created successfully!\n", sep = "")
cat("You can now import this GPX file into mapping software or view it on a GPS device.\n")

# Optional: View the first few rows of the extracted GPS data
print(head(gps_data))
```
